summary:
[  edit  ]
The Media File Info  DAT  encapsulates the essential metadata for a Media File. Metadata information like the codec, frame rate, audio sample rate, resolution etc is outputted.
A media file can be inputted to the  DAT  by either specifying the File path, or by referencing a  Movie File In TOP  or  Audio File In CHOP .

parameters.label: File
parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The path and name of the image or movie file to load. Image and movie formats are those found in  File Types .  You can specify files on the internet using  http://  ...

parameters.label: TOP / CHOP
parameters.name: topchop
parameters.description: Reference  to a  Movie File In TOP  or  Audio File In CHOP  to read file information from.

parameters.label: Reload  Pulse
parameters.name: reloadpulse
parameters.description: Change from 0 to 1 to force the file to reload, useful when the file changes or did not exist at first.

parameters.label: File Open Timeout
parameters.name: opentimeout
parameters.description: The time (in milliseconds) TouchDesigner will wait for a file to open. If the Disk Open Timout is reached, the Media File Info will stop waiting and output nothing. If the file still isn't opened the next time the  DAT  cooks, it'll wait again, and do the same. It'll keep doing this until the file is opened, or the open fails.

parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: To "pulse" a parameter is to send it a signal from (1) an  exported  CHOP channel or (2) a python command or (3) a mouse click that causes a new action to occur immediately. A pulse via python is via the  .pulse()  function on a pulse
parameters.description: type parameter, such as Reset parameter in a  Speed CHOP . A pulse from a CHOP is typically a 0 to 1 to 0 signal in an exported channel.
